lines.text: Why does the friend you helped most vanish when you need him?
Two moves. A five a.m. airport run. The interview that got him hired.
lines.say: Two moves. A five A M airport run. The interview that got him hired.

lines.text: He hugged you. "Bro, I owe you my life."
Then your car dies. One text. "Can't today, bro."
Then you see his story. Courtside. With his new boss.

lines.say: Law thirty one. Gratitude is a meme.

lines.text: It doesn't look back. It looks forward.
People show up for whoever matters next.
His boss can make him. You already did. Your favors are spent.
So stop pointing at the past. Show them what's coming.
The day you're worth betting on, your phone rings again.
People don't owe you for what you did.
They calibrate you for what you will do.
